application_sentences: nt details the specifications and features of the Hitachi High-Tech SU3900SE and SU3800SE series high-resolution Schottky Scanning Electron Microscopes (SEMs), designed for high-resolution imaging and analysis of large specimens with variable pressure capabilities.

Conclusion: The SU3900SE and SU3800SE series SEMs offer advanced imaging capabilities, robust specimen handling, and automation features, suitable for a wide range of analytical requirements in scientific and industrial applications.

Detectors include a 4+1-segment Semiconductor backscattered electron detector (BSED) with improved sensitivity suitable for highlighting composition information, and an ultra variable-pressure detector.
